best_idea: A fixed-step accumulator with a wall-time clamp, a stale-input rule that stops held movement after 0.75 s of silence, and a wall-clock meter that exposes the ticks the clamp hides.
decision_why: Frankendom needs the fixed step and the input staleness rule for server authority, but the donor's loop also drives world movement and mobs, so take only the loop shape and feed the engine's duel step into it.
acceptance: Server test: a 2 s stall in one timer callback runs at most 10 ticks and advances the sim clock by no more than 0.5 s; a player whose last input is more than 0.75 s old has no held movement applied; the achieved-rate read reports about 20 Hz after 3 s of steady ticks.
